subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel accept a new `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` plus hostname fallback, or should this PR be reshaped around the canonical resource-identity design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071?
rationale: The correctness of `service.instance.id` depends on a maintainer-approved identity source and privacy contract, not only on adding the semantic convention key.

options.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
options.body: Remove the custom env/hostname fallback and implement `service.instance.id` through the standard resource path or the approved OpenClaw runtime identity seam, with docs and exported-resource proof.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` intentionally, but require documented precedence, privacy expectations, upgrade behavior, and real export proof before merge.

options.title: Pause This PR
options.body: Leave this PR blocked or close it until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 settles the permanent resource identity contract.

recommendation.title: Align With Canonical Identity Design
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env/hostname fallback and implement `service.instance.id` through the standard resource path or the approved OpenClaw runtime identity seam, with docs and exported-resource proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the open canonical identity issue that asks for the stable instance-id source and final exported-resource proof.
